en-US.longDescription: the solstone app for windows takes in what you share with it from your screen, system audio, and any microphone you choose. it prepares local, owner-controlled segments for your journal. the solstone app runs on windows; your journal lives on a computer you own. no telemetry.
en-US.name: solstone
en-US.releaseNotes:
Added
- screenshots, a new source, adds the screenshots you take on this PC to your journal, and your journal keeps each one at the minute you took it. every picture saved in your Screenshots folder comes in. if you choose another folder, only what the solstone app can tell is a screenshot comes in, and the other files stay where they are. when you turn it on, you choose how far back to start, and you see how many screenshots there are before any come in. a screenshot you take while the solstone app is paused doesn't come in when you resume. when you pair a new journal, or your journal again, you choose how far back again, and the screenshots from that far back go into it, including ones your old journal already has.
- import, a new tile beside your sources, adds PDFs, audio, images and text to your journal. choose files on its page, or drop them on the settings window. each one waits on this PC until your journal has it, and the import page lists the ones still waiting. if your journal needs an update before it can take them, they wait for that, and the import page says so. a journal on a windows PC takes them once it's up to date. until then, each file shows what your journal said and stays on this PC.
Changed
- settings now opens on your sources. each one has a tile with its state, and audio, screen, screenshots and Obsidian have their switch right on the tile. beside the tiles, status shows how much each source has taken in for your journal since it started counting, and when it last took something in. a tile opens that source's page in place of status. on the left are home, your journal, this PC, updates and help.
- what you set under privacy is now on screen's page, under "left out", and shortcut and storage are under this PC.
- the tray icon's menu is now shorter. it names a source only when that source needs attention, and each source's state is on its tile in settings.
Fixed
- when you pair a new journal, or your journal again, your Obsidian notes go into it, as when you first turned Obsidian on. before, only notes you changed afterwards reached it.
